title: Terrorism in India: Data Visualization, 1947–2026
summary: A matplotlib data visualization of terrorism in India from 1947 to 2026. Built to handle gaps and conflicting numbers across different sources.
description: A data project examining terrorism in India across 1947 to 2026. Most of the work was source reconciliation because available records are uneven across decades and organisations count incidents differently. The project marks data gaps instead of smoothing them out.
role: Sole researcher. Framed the question, compared sources, prepared data, and built charts.

methodology.title: Framed the question narrowly
methodology.detail: Decided in advance what the charts would show so that gaps in data remain visible.

methodology.title: Compared sources
methodology.detail: Where numbers conflicted, both were recorded alongside the source difference.

methodology.title: Marked coverage gaps
methodology.detail: Periods with sparse records are marked clearly so absence of records is not read as absence of events.

methodology.title: Built charts in Python
methodology.detail: Used matplotlib so data transformations remain visible.

limitations: Records are incomplete, especially for earlier decades.
Different organisations count incidents differently, so figures from different sources cannot be directly compared.
The project maps available data. It does not establish causes.
The visualisations are exploratory, not a published conclusion.

title: Osho: Documentary-Style Research Document
summary: A long research document on Osho. It places competing historical accounts side by side instead of picking one narrative.
description: A research document about Osho written from published secondary sources. Because accounts of his life and organizations differ sharply, the document records competing accounts side by side and flags disputed claims.
role: Researcher and writer. Read sources, structured sections, and drafted text.
visibility: Research document. Not published as a public article.

methodology.title: Used published sources
methodology.detail: Compiled from public materials with source notes for each account.

methodology.title: Organized chronologically
methodology.detail: Used a timeline format to make sequence of events and divergence points clear.

methodology.title: Separated facts from interpretation
methodology.detail: Kept documented events distinct from interpretations and flagged disputed claims.

limitations: Accounts of Osho are contested. This document records competing versions without adjudicating between them.
This is a personal research document, not peer-reviewed scholarship.
Secondary sources carry their own biases.

title: Worksheet Generator
summary: A concept design for a school worksheet system split into four layers. No code exists for this project yet.
description: A design document for generating school worksheets. The core idea is separating content, layout, and styling into independent layers so each can change without breaking the others. This is a design document, not working software.
role: Product design and system architecture. Concept stage only.
visibility: Concept stage design. No code or prototype.

methodology.title: Content layer
methodology.detail: Stores questions, prompts, and metadata as structured data without layout assumptions.

methodology.title: Layout engine
methodology.detail: Calculates page arrangements, item flow, and page breaks for printing.

methodology.title: Template engine
methodology.detail: Provides reusable document styles and header patterns.

methodology.title: Optional assistance layer
methodology.detail: An optional layer for drafting content variations. The core three layers work without it.

limitations: This is a design document. No prototype or code exists.
The four layer split is untested against real classroom requirements.
Page pagination and layout overflow handling are not fully specified.
It has never been tested in a classroom.
